sumber: KSSM Form 2 English DSKP (CEFR-aligned). All passages and questions are written for the app.

topik.nama: 1. Grammar: Past Continuous and Past Simple

t: was/were + verb-ing for an action in progress in the past.
Often interrupted by the past simple: I was reading when he called.
Irregular verbs: go → went, eat → ate, write → wrote.
have/has + past participle: I have finished.
Finished time (yesterday, last year) → past simple.
Zero: If you heat ice, it melts.
First: If it rains, we will stay home.
Second: If I had time, I would …

topik.nama: 4. Vocabulary: Phrasal Verbs and Word Meaning

t: Phrasal verbs: give up, look after, find out, put off, call off.
Synonyms have similar meanings; antonyms have opposite meanings.
Skim for the main idea, scan for details.
Use context to guess the meaning of new words.
Paragraph: topic sentence, supporting details, example.
Linking words: furthermore, however, in conclusion.

nota.t: 24 questions from every chapter: easy to hard. Suggested time: 1 hour.
